repository PARK_FACTORS table (refresh yearly from Baseball Savant)
FanGraphs major-league batting leaderboard (wRC+, stats=bat, season=2026)
FanGraphs major-league pitching leaderboard (xFIP, SIERA, stats=pit, season=2026)
notes: FanGraphs-only backfill run: refreshed wrc_plus for all 30/30 teams in mlb_team_offense.csv, and xfip+siera for 851/852 pitchers in mlb_starters.csv.

Pitcher xFIP/SIERA sourced from FanGraphs stats=pit (all pitchers, overall season line), matched to StatsAPI rows by normalized name + mapped team abbreviation (ARI->AZ, CHW->CWS, KCR->KC, SDP->SD, SFG->SF, TBR->TB, WSN->WSH, OAK->ATH).

112 traded pitchers appear on FanGraphs as a combined 'N Tms' row (TeamNameAbb); accepted only when the name was a unique match and the combined row's ERA equaled the CSV's era exactly, pinning identity.

11 pitchers matched via nickname/full-name spelling variants (e.g. Cam vs Cameron Schlittler, Tyron vs Tayron Guerrero); accepted only because both the mapped team AND the ERA (to 2 decimals) matched exactly, which independently confirms identity beyond the name alone.

JoJo Romero (MIL) left blank for xfip/siera: FanGraphs' only name match is a combined '2 Tms' row whose ERA (3.35) does not equal the CSV's era (3.72), so identity could not be pinned per the traded-pitcher rule -- no invented value was written.
No Baseball-Reference OPS+ fallback was needed; FanGraphs reported wRC+ for all 30 teams.

No other columns or files were touched in this run; all other stats (StatsAPI hitting/pitching, slate, odds, weather, bullpen, park factors) are refreshed separately by the update_stats.yml GitHub Actions workflow.
